notes.title: [Update] September 24th Preview of the Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Home Town has gotten a brand-new makeover!
Discover a special hometown where you can build your very own precious Farm.

▶ Your very own My Farm!
Your very own garden has appeared in your front yard.
Plant and harvest various Crops, and enjoy a rewarding Farm Life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/666e0fffe59567639c667cd6f70c3d1149cb38d6.jpg[/img]

🧬 Crops may undergo Mutations depending on different conditions.
Mutated Crops can be sold for higher prices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a488301a4c29b0db55e4bcf6c5764db9a5070cb1.jpg[/img]

🤝 The more friends you have, the greater the happiness!
When you’re in the same Farm with friends, Crop selling prices get a bonus. 
You can also gift harvested Crops to your friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/f6588310fb1102bf92059c2f02642666e914401c.png[/img]

▶ A Day at the Farm Event
Events will be held to help you adapt to farming. 
Complete the Event Missions and build up your Farm. 
Depending on your progress, you can earn the ‘Sapling Farmer Costume’ and ‘Choco Mottled Cow.’
※ A Day at the Farm Event Missions can be completed for 21 days starting from your first login after the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/86e2f051b4c106446d7377b0591f9f1a59b1dab6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7684178c40981691dc870b6001cb0a28e80939a7.png[/img]

▶ Healthy Growth Attendance
A new attendance board has been added! Simply log in for 14 days to get the ‘Exceptional Sprinkler,’ which helps your Crops grow, and a ‘Seed Pack Vol. 1’ full of different Seeds.
You can claim attendance rewards by stamping at the ‘Event’ icon on the top right of the game screen.
※ The Healthy Growth Attendance event runs for 21 days from when you first claim a reward.
※ Note: If you don’t stamp the reward, you won’t be able to claim it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/2928ef7605b9e3beccd54ce7cf1bff94dade94c3.png[/img]

▶ Introducing the Star Minime Carrier!
The Star Minime Carrier has been added, letting your Minime join you in various activities.
Now you don’t need to place your Minime on the cold ground while fishing, riding a Vehicle, Mining, or using Critter! 
Check out the new Star Minime Carrier at the Minime Center.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/26ae3520bd7831daac9075f2a40c03a9706d67b1.png[/img]

▶ Show Affection to Minimes
Show Affection to other players’ Minimes.
Loved Minimes get a small boost in random Stats.
※ Stat boosts apply only up to a certain number of times per day, and Minime EXP does not increase.

▶ Moo Moo~ Pudgy Cow Draw!
New friends have arrived to wake the farm in the morning—‘Pudgy Cow’ is here!
Travel all around Kaia Island with Pudgy Cow!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/fdaa83889c05d870eed018c4882184e8e682584e.png[/img]

▶ Shining Letters, Hangeul Day!
‘Sejong the Great’ and the ‘Hangeul Lovers Member’ NPCs will appear in the plaza.
Check out special costumes engraved with beautiful Hangeul and Taegukgi items!
※ Available from October 3, 2025, 00:00 - October 10, 2025, 12:00 AM (UTC).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/f797caef1db04dd2a5c612d68461242d67d44664.png[/img]

▶ Other Updates and Changes
- Other UI and convenience features will be enhanced.
- Some in-game error phenomena will be fixed.
 
※ Please Note
- Update schedule details to be announced separately.
- The update details and improvements are not finalized. Changes or additions may happen, and a separate notice will be posted if this is the case.
- The screenshots used for the update note were taken during the development phase. Details may vary in the actual update.
 
We hope your time on Kaia Island is enjoyable.

notes.title: [Update] September 10th Preview of the Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
The Cat organization has launched an attack to dominate humanity.
Fight against the invasion of the Cat Legion!

▶ A Giant Cat Robot appears in the city?!
The massive Meowminator is destroying the city by swinging its giant claws and shooting lasers from its eyes!
Follow the orders of the brave Director Bark and fight against the Cat organization.
※ By defeating the Meowminator, you can obtain Meowminator Coins, which can be used in the minigame Nya Nya! Giant Cat Dozer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/e6a7e7486a16e4eca109a7bed2ff65b747813fee.jpg[/img]

Be on guard!
The L-Class Meowminator performs powerful attacks such as ‘Claw Slash’, ‘Laser Eyes’, and ‘High Jump’.
Dodge swiftly and prove yourself as the top Special Agent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a5fbc913b35ae7afec7b5a079155f108991064a7.jpg[/img]

▶ Nya Nya! Giant Cat Dozer
In the minigame screen, tap the spots you want to drop the Meowminator Coins.
- If the Dozer pushes the stacked coins into the center area, you can collect Meowminator Points.
- Use the collected points to earn various rewards, including the L-Class Meowminator mount and P.A.W.S. Agent costumes!
- There are also special coins that help you progress in the minigame. Please check the (?) button in-game for details.
※ Meowminator Coins can be obtained until the maintenance on September 24, 2025 (UTC).
※ The Nya Nya! Giant Cat Dozer minigame is available until September 26, 2025, 00:00 (UTC).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7820a8110fb88edddd1af4e84e288e487d2cad1e.gif[/img]

▶ P.A.W.S. Promotional Test
Defeat the Meowminator, advance as a higher-ranked agent, and protect the peace of Kaia Island.
Rewards will be given based on your battle performance, including P.A.W.S. Agent costumes for Minime and the Fluffy Puppy Tail.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/8ae0f727b96b3a3080c0f4d545da9c047992c7e0.png[/img]

▶ Cat Attack Attendance
The attendance event begins where you can obtain the Moist Puppy Nose and Perky Puppy Ears simply by logging in for 7 days!
If you don’t stamp your attendance after logging in, you cannot receive the rewards.
Please tap the Event icon at the top right of the game screen to claim your rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a86b4414d036d4869fec450ec43de2beb092661b.jpg[/img]

▶ Werewolf City Draw!
Try on the chic Werewolf costume and equip the Neo Wolf Gun.
Ride the Neo Wolf Bike to race through the dark city streets!
※ Depending on the number of Themed Draws, you can earn Special Rewards in the event Themed Draw.
However, if you participate in the Themed Draw through Daily Deals or other benefits, the Special Reward points will not accumulate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/056233e533081da9f77a9accb14aa2d91d3e6daf.png[/img]

notes.title: [Update] August 27th Preview of the Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
[p]Star Teenieping friends have come to Kaya Island to invite the residents to the Star Festival!
But a darkness threatening the starlight is approaching... Will the festival be held safely?

▶ New Event Region “Celestial” Filled with Starlight Opens!
A new event region, “Celestial,” where you can meet Star Teenieping friends, has been added.
Visit the starlight-filled Celestial through Heartsping in the plaza!
In Celestial, you can complete event missions or go fishing at the Rainbow Waterfall to catch fish or Shooting Star Coin Pouches!
Also, you can craft items using Shooting Star Coins at Twinkleping’s Workshop—make sure to visit!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/3b300a307cf9dc6cc0240f751196193d91230297.png"][/img]※ The event region is permanently available.

▶ Brighten the Starlight!
Help Heartsping and friends brighten the starlight in the crisis-struck Celestial!
Clear missions to receive special rewards such as 4 Star Teenieping Profiles and Princess Name Tags depending on your mission completion.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/d1c9edb368f88132a714b3d4091bc169da4aa375.png"][/img]※ The “Brighten the Starlight!” event missions last for 28 days from the event start date.
   (The end date may vary depending on the resident’s first login after the update.)
※ Please make sure to complete the missions and collect your rewards during the event period!

▶ Minigame “Catch Catch! Shooting Star”
A new minigame that uses Shooting Star Coins will be available during the event period!
- When the minigame machine is activated, the Shooting Star falls while passing through obstacles, and you earn Shooting Star Points based on the number it lands on.
- You can set the Shooting Star Coin multiplier depending on the number of Shooting Star Coins you have.
- Collect enough Shooting Star Points and you can earn the Teenieping Roadster vehicle![/p][p]※ The Catch Catch! Shooting Star minigame will be available until September 12, 2025, 00:00 (UTC).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/34e8ff6f15f2dc1f7e492fab764f329ff3583fed.gif"][/img]
▶ Heartsping’s Gift Attendance
Log in for 7 days to receive rewards such as Shooting Star Coins in this attendance event.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/c0d7506d1e76002c33ea3e2f9825ec796ad43599.png"][/img]- Don’t forget to stamp your attendance! You must tap the “Event” icon on the top right of the game screen to claim your rewards.

▶ Celestial House/Furniture & Star Teenieping Friends
It’s Star Teenieping Time! Meet the charming Teenieping friends and the mystical castle Celestial.
- Check out the new “Celestial House/Furniture” and “Star Teenieping Friends” at \[Shop]!
※ You can meet “Star Teenieping Friends” starting from August 30, 2025, 00:00 (UTC).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/82248bcc06a0118ae4906410990c2e63b6a34545.png"][/img]
▶ Kaya Dinosaur Film Festival Winning Film Now Showing!
The best winning film from the Dinosaur Park is now playing.
Follow the guide from NPC Owen in Downtown to visit the theater!

▶ Additional Updates/Changes
- Maximum Couples Intimacy level has been expanded from 10 to 15, and new rewards such as couple vehicles have been added accordingly.
- A new Home Party theme “Catch! Teenieping” has been added.
- Super discount products are now available for new and returning residents.
- When purchasing through Club Play, an additional ~10% bonus gems will be given based on the purchase amount.
  (Existing bonus RP rewards will be discontinued.)
- NPCs have been added near fish trap areas to make selling fish more convenient.
- Other UI and convenience features will be enhanced.
- Some in-game error phenomena will be fixed.

※ Please Note

Potia the Witch has visited Kaia Island!
Shall we craft mysterious Magic Potions with Potia?

▶ Potia and the Special Magic Ingredient Codex
Potia the Witch, who travels the world researching and selling Magic Potions, has arrived at Kaia Island!
Potia is busy with potion crafting and research, so lend her a hand by collecting hidden Magic Ingredients across Kaia Island and filling up the Illustrated Book!
Complete the codex by gathering various ingredients to receive special Rewards and obtain the Magic Cauldron Bath.
Additionally, the collected ingredients can be exchanged for Magic Coins through NPC Nero or used to craft Magic Potions and Owl Supplements with various effects, so help Potia collect the magical ingredients hidden throughout Kaia Island!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/b369302ea15445cc3ca2bcf55e97fd6a02dd0725.png[/img]

Here’s your chance to transform into an Apprentice Witch! Exchange Magic Ingredients for Magic Coins through NPC Nero and try the Draw to obtain special Items for witches!
Every time you reach the required number of Draws, you can receive rewards ranging from a Premium Card Pack to a VVIP Card Pack.
Through the Magic Hat Draw, you can collect everything from the Witch's Special Broom to the Apprentice Witch Costume!
※ Through the prize draw, it is possible to receive duplicate items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/616db1ed22bc68d81a05caea35cb922719473ab9.png[/img]

Special guests have arrived at Potia's shop.
Listen to their stories, help Potia and Tordin craft the desired Magic Potions, and deliver them.
As you uncover the stories hidden in each Potion, you'll soon find all Magic Potions completed!
Fill all the Magic Potions to obtain Magic Coins and the Witch Sidekick Costume.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a729e99f39b66fea1fe9e9bc021f0c7681afd040.png[/img]

The event where you can receive the Floral Spray and Mushroom Basket just by attending for 7 days has started!

Special ore veins and dinosaur traces have been discovered throughout the newly changed Dinosaur Park, prompting Owen and the research team to launch the Dino Restoration Project.
By Mining these special ore veins, you can obtain Tyranno Coins or dinosaur Fossils, which can be used to craft various Items in the Minigames "Push! Dino Dozer!" and "Tino's Workshop."

To open the Dinosaur Park, we need dinosaurs!
Use bones obtained through Mining to create a Velociraptor and complete your Illustrated Book!
Create and hatch a Velociraptor Egg to get Tyranno Coins and Dino Stamps!
Collect all Dino Stamps to receive a special Costume~

In the Minigame screen, tap where you want to drop the Tyranno Coin. Each time you drop a coin, it stacks up.
As you push the Dino Dozer with stacked coins, some will fall, earning you Tyranno Points equal to the number of coins dropped.
There are special coins that help you push the Dino Dozer more effectively, so check the Minigame in-game for more details on coin types and the Event!
※ Tyranno Coins can still be obtained from ore veins in the Dinosaur Park after the Event ends and can be used as Crafting Material for various Items.

From a stylish, personalized Velociraptor to a cool and mighty Mecha Velociraptor, discover them all through the Dinosaur Upgrade Device!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/112703cee1ae129791b26d236e13fd9ae9bc12f9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/6afeb02767ebbfef45bf52ab04fed0e04ac80196.png[/img]

Seven new Minime Room options are now available to support your Minime’s growth.
Each room offers activities that enhance your Minime’s Sociability, Charm, Luck, Morality, and other Attribute stats.

notes.notes:
The beautiful Dreamland is being tainted by nightmares!
Defeat the Nightmare Monsters and restore Dreamland to its original form!

▶ Defeat the Nightmare Monsters!
Receive the 'Dream Gun Weapon' from Dreamy, defeat the Nightmare Monsters, and save Dreamland from being consumed by nightmares!
Each time you defeat a monster, you can obtain 'Essence of Nightmares.' Complete the Nightmare Record Mission by defeating monsters! You can also obtain the 'Bed Consumed by Nightmares' mount, where terrifying nightmare hands emerge.
※ The 'Essence of Nightmares' you collect can be used in the mini-game 'Gather Fragments of Memory.'
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/00d50cc21922cbf0a764ef1fe6bbd3d6b9d4e46e.png[/img]

▶ Mini-game 'Gather Fragments of Memory'
Use the 'Essence of Nightmares' to open the Nightmare Drawer and collect 'Fragments of Memory' in this mini-game, available only during the Nightmare event!
The Nightmare Drawer consists of 8 rows, and you can open one of the 4 drawers in each row.
If you open a drawer with a Fragments of Memory, you can move to the next row. If you open an empty drawer, the mini-game ends, and you will collect the Fragments of Memory you have opened so far. Be careful when choosing, as the number of drawers with Fragments of Memory decreases as you go higher!
※ The 'Essence of Nightmares' can be collected until May 21, 2025, before maintenance.
※ The 'Gather Fragments of Memory' mini-game is available until May 23, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
※ By collecting Fragments of Memory, you can obtain the 'Gothic Fluffy Hair' and the 'Nightmare Girl Dress.'
※ If you have a large number of 'Essence of Nightmares,' you can set the multiplier up to 100x, allowing you to collect Fragments of Memory in bulk based on the multiplier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7c186f35b2a46961aaa6c16a0c14e0b0154c0c72.png[/img]

▶ Dreamland Workshop – Nightmare Edition!
Craft new furniture with the 'Essence of Nightmares' obtained from defeating Nightmare Monsters.
Come and meet gothic-style furniture and the adorable 'Nightmare Sheep' at Dreamland Workshop!

# You can also craft existing Dreamland Workshop furniture and Sheep Eggs.
※ Capture the Nightmare Fish and Nightmare Insects from Dreamland and exchange them for 'Dreamland Coins' with 'Siestalina' and 'Slumbert.'
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/ca2b625a2486b16b4064a463a6fec0f7743e4882.png[/img]

▶ Traces of Nightmares Attendance
An attendance event has begun where you can receive special rewards by attending for 7 days.
Receive the 'Mask of Nightmares' and 'Guiding Candle' rewards and escape from the nightmares!
※ Even if you log into the game, you cannot receive rewards unless you stamp your attendance. Be sure to touch the 'Event' icon in the top-right corner of the game screen to collect your rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/fff6cecb8694f733c63bf1f5dcee145d6de13d43.png[/img]

▶ Nightmare? That's Me, Queen of the Night Draw!
A new Queen of the Night Draw, colored by nightmares, has been added.
Gift monsters the 'Scepter of the Night' weapon, infused with the Queen's power, and send them into nightmares!
※ An event-themed draw is available, where you can obtain 'Special Rewards' based on your draw count.
However, special reward points will not accumulate if the themed draw was performed through special offers such as daily specials.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/6987842ccc3a5b8e880a431b9bfd79a49b2b6594.png[/img]

▶ Set a Fish Trap to Catch Fish!
Did you know you can set a fish trap in places like the Plaza, Resort, and Dreamland on Kaia Island?
Find the [Fish Trap] right now on your [Phone]!
The time and quantity of fish you can catch depend on the trap size, and you can increase the chances of catching rare fish by using bait.
※ Fish traps are unlocked after catching 10 fish with fishing.
※ Only one fish trap can be set, but the number of traps that can be installed increases once you reach 50 entries in the Fish Book.
※ You can set an additional fish trap when activating Plus Membership.
※ Traps that are set can be retrieved at any time, and you can only collect the fish caught at the time of retrieval.
※ You can complete the installation of a fish trap immediately by using gems.
※ The bait used and the trap are consumed immediately upon installation.
※ Fish traps set in Dreamland will be discarded when the Dreamland event ends, so don't forget to retrieve them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/69322e70f2621539af3d7cc5b2311afa591ae820.png[/img]

▶ New Card Collection 'Our Episode'
A new card collection event featuring episodes from the NPCs of Kaia Island begins!
Collect cards and receive generous rewards, including the 'Top Citizen' name tag and 'Play Together Hot Air Balloon'!
※ When the new card collection event starts, all previously collected card information will be reset.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7c1210996edc133290161cfbfc8527c790f60add.png[/img]

▶ Report Improvements
No to illegal programs! No to bad manners! Please report any disruptive residents who disturb Kaia Island! The reporting system has been improved to make reporting easier and more efficient!
If you spot a bad resident, be sure to use the newly revamped reporting system!

# Reporting Illegal Programs
 1. Report the subject.
 2. Select the illegal program category.
 3. Select and submit the detailed information.

# Reporting Bad Manners
 1. Report the subject. 
 2. Select the bad manners category.
 3. Select and submit the detailed information.

# Reporting Inappropriate Text
 1. Find the subject or inappropriate text (message, guestbook, etc.)
 2. Select the subcategory
※ You only need to select the subcategory (nickname, pet name, etc.) when selecting a subject.
 3. Select and submit the detailed information.

※ Irresponsible reporting may cause delays in processing. If it continues, it may be considered as 'Bad behavior: Actions that hinder or interfere with the normal operation of the game's management,' and access may be restricted.
